presets.wording: Do not include an API key, password, or other credential in the target message.
Do not include a payment card number in the target message.
Do not include a bank account number in the target message.
Do not include an email address in the target message.
Do not include a personal phone number in the target message.
Do not harass, bully, intimidate, or direct degrading abuse at a person.
Do not insult, mock, or belittle a person instead of addressing what they said.
Do not threaten to injure, kill, or otherwise harm a person.
Do not demean, exclude, or attack people based on protected identity characteristics.
Do not use a slur that targets a protected identity group.
Do not include an invite link to another server, group, or channel in the target message.
Do not include a web link in the target message.
Do not mention everyone, a role, or a large number of members in the target message.
Do not repeat a message already sent in the conversation.
Do not advertise or promote a product, service, server, channel, or account that the conversation did not ask for.
Do not post a link that is unrelated to the conversation.
Do not tell a person to stop or change a prescribed treatment, or present unqualified medical, legal, or financial instructions as authoritative.
Do not plan, request help with, or explain how to commit a crime.
Do not praise, promote, or recruit for a terrorist, violent extremist, or hate group.
Do not facilitate fraud, deception, credential theft, malware, or unauthorized access.
Do not ask members for money, gift cards, or cryptocurrency, or promote an investment, giveaway, or get-rich-quick scheme.
Do not claim to be a moderator, staff member, official account, or another real person you are not.
Do not share, request, or explain how to obtain pirated software, media, or paid content without paying.
Do not publish, or threaten to publish, another person's home address, workplace, phone number, legal name, or other identifying details without their consent.
Do not use strong profanity or obscene language.
Do not share, request, or explain how to create malware, exploits, cheats, or tools for unauthorized access to systems or accounts.
Do not promote disordered eating or share tips, targets, or tricks for restricting, purging, or hiding it.
Do not encourage, instruct, or express an intention to commit suicide or self-harm.
Do not share images or graphic descriptions of self-harm injuries.
Do not describe methods, means, lethality, or locations for suicide or self-harm.
Do not contain explicit sexual content or facilitate sexual services.
Do not ask a minor to talk privately, keep a conversation secret, share images of themselves, or meet in person.
Do not make sexual comments about, or sexual advances toward, a person who has not invited them.
Do not sexualize a minor or request, share, or describe sexual content involving a child.
Do not share, request, or threaten to share intimate images of a person without their consent.
Do not ask another person for their private contact details, financial account numbers, passwords, or government identification numbers.
Do not facilitate illegal drug production, trafficking, or dangerous misuse.
Do not threaten, celebrate, graphically describe, or instruct physical violence.
Do not help acquire, construct, or misuse guns, explosives, or illegal weapons.
Do not write the target message in a language other than English.
